question: Who wrote 'The Jungle Book' in 1894?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rudyard Kipling**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'The Jungle Book'** was written by **Rudyard Kipling** and published in the year **1894**.
 
• The book is a collection of stories, featuring the adventures of **Mowgli**, a human child raised by wolves in the jungle.
 
• Rudyard Kipling was born on **30th December 1865** in **Bombay (now Mumbai), India**, and is known for his works that explore themes of British colonialism.
 
• Kipling’s mastery in storytelling brought to life the rich fauna of the Indian jungle, such as **Bagheera (the panther), Baloo (the bear), and Shere Khan (the tiger)**.
 
• The book is widely regarded as a classic of children’s literature and has been adapted into numerous films, plays, and animations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rudyard Kipling**:

 
 
• He was awarded the **Nobel Prize in Literature** in **1907**, making him the youngest recipient of the prize at the time.
 
• His other famous works include **'Kim'**, **'The Man Who Would Be King'**, and poems like **'If—'** and **'Gunga Din'**.
 
• Kipling's writing style is characterized by vivid descriptions, moral lessons, and the integration of British imperial themes.
 
 
 
• **About 'The Jungle Book'**:
 
 
• The book contains a total of **seven stories**, many of which revolve around Mowgli, while some feature other characters like **Rikki-Tikki-Tavi**, a brave mongoose.
 
• It explores themes such as the importance of **family, loyalty, and identity**.
 
• The "Law of the Jungle" is a recurring motif, symbolizing rules and ethics in a complex society.
 
 
 
• **Other Options:**
 
 
• **William Shakespeare**: He was a famous English playwright and poet from the Elizabethan era, known for works like **'Hamlet'**, **'Macbeth'**, and **'Romeo and Juliet'**. He did not write 'The Jungle Book'.
 
• **Stephen Alter**: An Indian-American author known for books on Himalayan ecology and culture, but he is not connected to 'The Jungle Book'.
 
• **Edgar Allan Poe**: An American writer famous for his gothic tales and poems such as **'The Raven'** and **'The Tell-Tale Heart'**. He did not write 'The Jungle Book'.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Inspiration for 'The Jungle Book'**: Kipling was inspired by his childhood in India, particularly the wildlife and culture he observed.
 
• **Legacy**: Disney adapted 'The Jungle Book' into an animated movie in **1967**, and a live-action remake was released in **2016**.
 
• **Impact**: The book has been used as a teaching tool for children to understand moral values and the importance of coexistence with nature.
